Pasiv: Turn your idle PC into crypto paid directly to your | BetaList

## Turn your idle PC into crypto paid directly to your wallet

 

 

 

 

Pasiv lets you earn crypto by mining with hardware you already have. Install the desktop app, paste a payout address, and start mining coins like Monero, Pearl, Verus, Ravencoin, Ergo, Zephyr, and Salvium using your CPU or NVIDIA GPU. The app auto-detects what your machine can handle, runs in the background, and pays you directly from the pool without accounts or custody. Pasiv charges a 4% fee on Monero only and 0% on other coins, with transparent on-chain fee logging.

# ReClaim Miles: Rebuild IRS-compliant mileage logs offline | BetaList

title: Reclaim Miles
body:
ReClaim Miles: Rebuild IRS-compliant mileage logs offline | BetaList

ReClaim Miles is a Windows desktop app that helps US business owners, contractors, and accountants reconstruct IRS-compliant mileage logs without real-time GPS tracking. It uses odometer readings from service receipts, road network data, and fuel/EV physics to backfill missed months and generate clean PDF summaries. The app keeps all data local for privacy, avoids battery drain, and offers lifetime licenses for freelancers, small businesses, and CPAs.

 Rudolf Gorel
